sentences.text: Timothy Allen Dick -LRB- born June 13 , 1953 -RRB- , known professionally as Tim Allen , is an American actor , comedian and author .

He is known for his role as Tim `` The Toolman '' Taylor in the ABC television show Home Improvement -LRB- 1991 -- 1999 -RRB- as well as for his starring roles in several films , including the role of Buzz Lightyear in the Toy Story franchise .	television	television	ABC	American Broadcasting Company	television show	television show	Home Improvement	Home Improvement (TV series)	Buzz Lightyear	Buzz Lightyear
